Evan (eng): 8 minutes out. Tiny logistics update: moving roadmap deep-dive to after Q&A, need to cut 6 minutes from the demo. Also need quick AV validation.
Lina (prod): Leadership requested two clarifying bullets on Dedicated GA timing during the wrap. I'll prep wording.
Kai (infra): Captioner spiked earlier, bumped replica count 5m ago. Watching CPU and queue length.
Maya (comms): Can presenters drop full names + pronouns for the recording metadata? I'll attach to the post.
Ruth (design): Stripped slide transitions and compressed images. Uploaded: drive.company/allhands/trim_v4.pptx
Evan (eng): If OBS hiccups, fallback plan: stop stream push, keep local recording, and note gap in the post. Quick restart steps:
```
pkill -f obs || true
sleep 2
obs --startrecording --minimize-to-tray &
```
Expect ~12s gap.
allhands-bot: Recording will begin in 2 minutes. Join: https://zoom.company/all-hands
Kai (infra): I'll tail captions and stream logs: `tail -n200 /var/log/captions.log /var/log/stream.log | grep -iE "error|fail|retry"`
Lina (prod): Please drop urgent live Qs here; formal follow-ups go in the GDoc. I'll filter and tag leadership.
Maya (comms): I'll post speaker roster in 90s and pin. Setting transcript retention = 48h.
Ruth (design): Presenters, avoid rapid slide animations during metrics; encoder spikes happened last time.
Evan (eng): Network note: if RTMP latency rises >25s flip to recording-only via `systemctl stop streamproxy` on the host.
Kai (infra): Monitoring network and caption latency metrics. Will flip to fallback caption host if >15% errors for 60s.
Lina (prod): Thanks all. See you in room. I'll keep the thread for live blockers only.
Evan (eng): Closing prep. Good luck! :thumbsup:
